title: reserveAgentTool
responsibility: Atomically reserves an allowed tool dispatch in the journal or issues an expiring, request-bound approval.

inputs.name: requiresAgentToolApproval.action
inputs.description: The operation class declared by the trusted tool implementation.

inputs.name: reserveAgentTool.journal
inputs.description: The active host transaction for durable admission.

inputs.name: reserveAgentTool.attempt
inputs.description: Host-generated identity and clock metadata for this attempt.

inputs.name: reserveAgentTool.admission
inputs.description: Validated adapter arguments, resource, action and policy snapshot.

inputs.name: reserveAgentTool.approvalId
inputs.description: Optional owner approval. Without it, a risky request returns a pending challenge.

outputs.name: requiresAgentToolApproval
outputs.description: Whether policy requires an exact owner approval for this operation.

outputs.name: reserveAgentTool
outputs.description: A denial, or an exact challenge for confirmation, or undefined after a durable reservation.
